answer_1.quote: Instruction synthesis plays a fundamental role in enabling large language models (LLMs) to perform a wide array of real-world dialogue tasks.

answer_2.quote: We employed three representative multi-turn dialogue benchmarks to evaluate the performance of our models: LIGHT and TOPDIAL, which are used to evaluate chat consistency in multi-turn dialogues, and MT-EVAL, which assesses comprehensive multi-turn conversational abilities.
